proposals.new_string: 1. **ST6 is opt-in** — `GEN3 ST6` sets both the wind side (`LWINDM=8` → `IWIND=8` when wind is present) and the whitecapping side (`IWCAP=8`) in one command at `[file=src/swanpre1.ftn line=2983-2991]`; there is no separate `WCAP ST6` keyword (`WCAP` options are KOMEN/JANSSEN/LHIG/BJ/KBJ/AB — `[file=src/swanpre1.ftn line=2459]`).
